strings.ui.translationReview: Ukuhumusha kwesiBhunu nesiZulu kubhalwe ngomshini; ukubuyekezwa yizikhulumi zomdabu kusalindile.
strings.ui.heroDescription: Sitshele okwenzekile. I-CivicOps ihlanganisa izwi, amathikithi ezinkonzo ne-AI enokuziphendulela edeskini elilodwa. Umthumeli ugunyaza konke ukwabiwa kwethimba.
strings.ui.emergencyNumbers: Leli deski alikwazi ukuthumela abezimo eziphuthumayo. Uma kunengozi esheshayo eNingizimu Afrika shayela u-10111 (amaphoyisa), u-10177 (i-ambulensi/umlilo) noma u-112 kumakhalekhukhwini.
strings.ui.emergencySafety: Gwema izintambo ezivulekile, umlilo namanzi ezikhukhula. Asikwazi ukuthembisa isikhathi sokufika.
strings.ui.descriptionPlaceholder: Chaza inkinga nanoma yiziphi izingozi. Sebenzisa imininingwane yokwenziwa kule demo.
strings.ui.descriptionHint: Izinhlamvu eziyi-10–4 000. Indawo nokudluliselwa akuqinisekisiwe kuze kubuyekezwe ngabasebenzi. Gwema amagama, izinombolo zikamazisi nemininingwane yomuntu ebucayi.
strings.ui.contactConsent: Ngiyavuma ukuthola ukwaziswa ngenkonzo ngale ndlela yokuxhumana.
strings.ui.privacyConsent: Ngiyavuma ukucutshungulwa ngale njongo yombiko wenkonzo (isaziso sobumfihlo v1).
strings.ui.privacyOfficerPending: Ukuxhumana neSikhulu Solwazi: kusalindwe umnikazi. Sebenzisa idatha yokwenziwa kuze umasipala ashicilele isaziso sobumfihlo esigunyaziwe.
strings.ui.privateHint: Iseshini yangasese ye-ElevenLabs iqala uma ukhetha indlela. Izwi lisebenzisa umbhobho wakho; imininingwane yeseshini ihlala enkumbulweni.
strings.ui.simulatedHint: Umsizi wabahlali olingiswayo · usebenza ngemithetho futhi ngaphandle kwezinsizakalo zangaphandle lapho iseva itholakala. Imibiko isebenzisa amathuluzi afanayo nomsizi wezwi osebenzayo.
strings.ui.greeting: Sawubona. Chaza inkinga nendawo, noma faka inombolo yecala ukuze uhlole isimo. Umuntu ugunyaza konke ukuthunyelwa.
strings.ui.chatConsent: Ngiyavuma ukuthi umasipala acubungule lo mbiko ukuze ahlole futhi aphathe inkonzo (isaziso sobumfihlo v1). Ukuxhumana kungokuzikhethela.
strings.ui.agentUnavailable: Izwi/ingxoxo ayitholakali kulesi siphequluli. Sebenzisa ifomu lombiko bese ugcina inombolo yecala.
strings.ui.zuluVoiceUnavailable: Izwi lesiZulu elisebenzayo alilungiselelwe noma liqinisekisiwe. Sebenzisa ifomu lombiko lesiZulu noma ideski lombhalo elilingiswayo. Izilungiselelo zezwi lesiNgisi nesiBhunu zidinga ukuqinisekiswa ngumnikazi.
strings.ui.reportSuccess: Inombolo yecala {reference}. Umbiko wakho ulinde ukubuyekezwa ngumuntu. Gcina le nombolo; asithembisi isikhathi sokufika.
strings.ui.referenceNotFound: Inombolo yecala ayitholakali. Hlola inombolo bese uzama futhi.
strings.ui.offlineError: Ayixhumekile. Xhuma futhi ngaphambi kokuthumela. Umbhalo wakho nokhiye wokuzama futhi kugcinwa kule thebhu.
strings.ui.chatAcceptPrivacy: Sicela wamukele injongo yobumfihlo yombiko wenkonzo ngaphambi kokuthumela.
strings.ui.requestFailed: Isicelo sehlulekile ({status}). Zama futhi noma usebenzise ifomu lombiko.
strings.ui.rateLimit: Umkhawulo wezicelo ufinyelelwe. Sicela uzame futhi ngomzuzu.
strings.ui.connected: IXHUMEKILE · Kudingeka ukugunyazwa ngumuntu kukho konke ukuthunyelwa

strings.privacy.purpose: Hlola, dlulisela futhi uphathe inkinga yenkonzo kamasipala ebikiwe; thumela ukwaziswa ngenkonzo kuphela uma kucelwe ngokwehlukana.
strings.privacy.notice: Ngiyavuma ukuthi umasipala wami acubungule lo mbiko ukuze ahlole futhi aphathe inkinga yenkonzo. Imininingwane yokuxhumana ingokuzikhethela futhi isetshenziselwa ukwaziswa ngenkonzo kuphela ngemvume yami ehlukile. Ngingacela ukufinyelela, ukulungiswa noma ukufihlwa kobunikazi kuSikhulu Solwazi. Ngizogwema izinombolo zikamazisi nemininingwane yomuntu ebucayi.
strings.error.privacyConsent: Kudingeka imvume ecacile yenjongo yombiko wenkonzo eshiwo.
strings.error.privacyVersion: Yamukela inguqulo yamanje yemvume yobumfihlo ngaphambi kokuthumela.
strings.error.invalidReport: Hlola izinkambu zombiko bese uzama futhi.
strings.tool.reportRecorded: Umbiko wakho urekhodwe ukuze ubuyekezwe ngumuntu. Sicela ugcine inombolo yecala. Alikho ithimba elithunyelwe.

strings.tool.handoffRecorded: Isicelo sakho sokusizwa ngumuntu sirekhodwe. Umthumeli uzosibuyekeza; asithembisi isikhathi sokufika.
strings.tool.infoRecorded: Imininingwane yakho eyengeziwe irekhodwe ukuze ibuyekezwe ngumuntu.

strings.privacy.locationNotice: Izixhumanisi zendawo yombiko ziyazikhethela. Khetha shareLocation kuphela ukuvumela abasebenzi abagunyaziwe bakamasipala ukuthi bathole indawo yalo mbiko, banikeze iwadi futhi babuyekeze ukuthunyelwa kwethimba. Izixhumanisi aziqinisekisiwe, zigcinwa naleli cala ngokwenqubomgomo yokugcina futhi zingalungiswa noma zenziwe zingahlonzi ngomuntu ngeSikhulu Solwazi. I-CivicOps ayilandeli izakhamuzi.
